target.version_evidence: Bundled release_notes.txt begins with version 1.15, August 30, 2010; PE timestamp agrees with that date.

required_outcome.engine: An independently implemented vectorization engine with the same observable behavior as the selected target.
required_outcome.cli: Expose processing, editing, batch, configuration, and export operations from a terminal.
required_outcome.gui: A custom GUI using the same engine and document model as the CLI.
required_outcome.distribution: A publishable npm package exposing the library and CLI.
required_outcome.license: MIT for the independently authored implementation
required_outcome.session_model: Retain one shared core PRNG across processing operations in an application session. Native stage-by-stage captures show that anti-alias contour smoothing also consumes this state. Loading a new image does not reset it. A fresh CLI invocation starts a fresh session.

completion_criteria: The package processes images on a machine where Vector Magic is not installed.
The CLI and custom GUI use one canonical engine and document model.
Every processing and editing feature below has an executable behavior test against a reference with known settings.
Segment topology, colors, alpha, curve geometry, corner decisions, and export options agree with the original for the reference corpus.
Any serialization differences are identified explicitly; visual similarity alone does not establish 1:1 behavior.
The npm package contains the new implementation and its dependencies, excluding investigation evidence and original application files.
